paragraphs: Hearing this almost shameless response, Bai Qiuqin only frowned slightly, showing no displeasure. "There are many members of our family waiting to marry. If you need one, we can find one to marry you. They're all ladies from prominent families, beautiful as flowers, and possess great refinement. They'll be a great help to you as a wife."

"No, I don't need a slut. Is there anything else you want to discuss? We can put this aside for now." Zhao An showed no interest. Returning? No kidding, that would just mean returning to be someone's grandson. He had no such idea.

Bai Qiuqin had never met anyone like this before. "The Bai family has extensive resources in the industries you want to develop. With the Bai family's support, you can save yourself a lot of unnecessary trouble, which will be very beneficial to you. As for trouble, I believe it's normal to assume some obligations while gaining some benefits, isn't it?"

"No, I'm a lazy person. I don't need it. Would you say that when I was broke? Everything is about profit. Without profit, I'm afraid I'd be nothing but a piece of shit in the eyes of the Bai family, right?" Zhao An sneered as he tapped away at the keyboard, then changed his expression. "Oh, of course. I'm a very straightforward person. Don't mind."
The atmosphere seemed a little awkward, and the negotiations reached a stalemate.

The main reason was that Bai Qiuqin hadn't realized that anyone would refuse such a good thing. For ordinary people, it was a blessing. She thought she didn't have enough bargaining chips, and the reason she refused was because the chips were not high enough.
"What do you want in exchange for returning to the Bai family?" Bai Qiuqin handed the right to negotiate back to Zhao An. No matter what the price was, she was confident she could bargain it down.

"Well, it's nothing. I simply don't want to go back. If I don't go, I can still be my boss, living a peaceful life. Going back and being a grandson of the Bai family? I'm not into that kind of thing. If you don't want to discuss business, please leave. I'm not interested!" Zhao An solemnly declined this time, not even entertaining such an idea.
This truly surprised Bai Qiuqin. No one had ever refused the Bai family's invitation; it was an honor. Now, someone treated that honor like dirt. This infuriated her!
"Do you know what you're doing? Do you understand what you're saying?"

"Of course I do. What's the matter? Are you going to threaten me if you can't recruit me? I'm really looking forward to it!" Zhao An crossed his arms, feigning a relaxed demeanor, a hint of disdain twitching at the corners of his mouth.

If it were anyone else, Bai Qiuqin would have undoubtedly started threatening, but Zhao An was no ordinary man. Everyone could see the income from the livestreaming platform, and his streams were very standardized, without any nudity or anything like that. There was nothing to find fault with them.
Furthermore, they've also launched a food delivery platform, a powerful tool for uniting users and merchants.

The latest news is that Zhao An has given 30% of his shares to the government, directly to the highest level of authority. With government control, he's clearly committed to profiting and handing oversight to the government. While the details of the proposed agreement are unclear, it's at least a mutually beneficial partnership.
This approach sacrifices some profits, but it's incredibly safe. With government backing, what could be safer?

It was this very reason that kept Bai Qiuqin from acting rashly. If she could recruit the other party, it would be a truly advantageous opportunity. Having a powerful ally would be a significant advantage, at least in the competition within the family.

"How could that be? If you're willing to return, I'm always welcome here. If you're not interested for the time being, we can continue our cooperation." Bai Qiuqin offered a gentle smile. There was no need to turn hostile. Creating an enemy out of thin air was irrational. Members of large families don't care about face or preferences; profit is the only thing that matters. Only after ensuring sufficient profit can there be subsequent respect.
"Not interested. Are you done? If you're done, please leave. Goodbye." Zhao An made no move to get up, seemingly too lazy to even see him off.

Bai Qiuqin wasn't angry, nor did she get up. Instead, she smiled and said, "I wonder what industries Mr. Zhao is interested in? Any new industrial investment plans? Perhaps we could engage in in-depth cooperation."

"No, but I'm interested in a deeper exchange." Zhao An lit a cigarette, then seemed to think of something. He pulled two packs of cigarettes from the cabinet and placed them on the table. "Take these with you when you leave. They're tobacco cigarettes, not for sale. One pack is 200,000 yuan, a pack is 400,000 yuan, and a pack is 4 million yuan. Smoke sparingly. Tell your master, forget about returning, I'm not interested in being anyone's grandson, but we can discuss cooperation later."
Bai Qiuqin picked up the cigarettes with some curiosity. "Are these the cigarettes you smoke? Very luxurious, very expensive."

It was indeed expensive. For a heavy smoker, two packs a day wouldn't be a problem. Even if it was one pack a day, that would be thirty packs a month, which would cost 12 million yuan a month. And that's just one person. If they were to open up for sale later, it would be hard to say.

"If you have money, you have to spend it. Otherwise, what are you going to do with it? Save it for your grave? Or keep it for having children?" Zhao An sneered. Only a miser would do that. If you have money, you have to spend it. Spend it on women!

"Okay, I'll convey your request to the head of the household. Are you free at noon? We can have lunch together," Bai Qiuqin offered. This Zhao An was truly a difficult person to deal with. If he had low emotional intelligence, he'd even offered a gift and apologized. If he had high emotional intelligence, why would he refuse to come back?

"Not interested. Your fiancé wouldn't agree, haha. Okay, I have things to do. That's it for now. When you have a collaborative project, call me or my secretary. I'm very busy." Zhao An stood up to see him off, making an inviting gesture.

Bai Qiuqin also walked down the stairs and picked up two packs of cigarettes. "Okay, I just happened to have a project coming up. I'll prepare the materials for you when the time comes. If you're interested, we can work together."
Bai Qiuqin suddenly felt a nudge against her hip. Turning around, she saw Zhao An, looking composed and seemingly lewd. "You seem to like women?"

paragraphs: Park Jae-yong and Zhao An exchanged a glance; the two sinister individuals seemed to share a common accord.
They weren't close friends, just business partners with whom they could continue their discussions.

"Your invention is unique in the world. Perhaps there will be others in the future, but right now, you only have this one. Have you considered licensing your patented technology to us? We won't be stingy with the patent fees, and we can also collaborate in other areas." Park Jae-yong immediately began to negotiate.

"Let's talk about it after the tour. My patents aren't easily loaned out. The Android smartphone market has given us three months to seize the market. Others certainly have R&D, but they're nowhere near as advanced as mine. Three months later, my version has already been updated ten times, while theirs is still just the basics. How can they compete with us?" Zhao An spoke as he walked, his tone brimming with pride.
The more he looked, the more alarmed he became. Zhao An made no attempt to conceal his true intentions. At this production rate, they'd probably already produced over three million phones.
"Mr. Zhao, aren't you worried that such a rapid production rate might leave some of the survivors stranded?" Lee Boo-jin expressed her doubts.

Zhao An turned to look at the eldest daughter of the Sanxing Group. She was still very young, in her twenties, perhaps around twenty-five, a college graduate who had come to work for the family business. She was youthful and energetic, and more importantly, she possessed that youthful exuberance that only a young woman possesses. This was the true difference between a young woman and a mature woman.
The youthful vigor of a young woman, her longing for life, was infectious. A mature woman, having weathered the test of time and the rigors of life, was left with a calm and composed demeanor.

Lee Boo-jin met Zhao An's gaze for the first time, gazing at this young man from a foreign land. She was already a graduate student in the United States, a very bright one. Now that she had met someone even smarter and younger, she was immediately intrigued.
In reality, Zhao An's assets were a drop in the bucket compared to the Sanxing Group, barely even the tip of the iceberg.
In a head-to-head battle, the Sanxing Group would undoubtedly win. But even if they won, it was a pyrrhic victory, ultimately giving their competitors the opportunity to swallow them up.
No one would do such a foolish thing, and this was another scene of cooperation.

Zhao An also looked at the young Lee Boo-jin. "The eldest princess of Sanxing Group is indeed very beautiful. You are quite good, very independent and brave, and you dared to say no to your own marriage."
"What do you mean?" Park Jae-yong was a little confused.

A hint of sarcasm curled the corners of Zhao An's mouth. "It's simple. I think Miss Lee Boo-jin's boyfriend is just a security guard. You probably don't know that he used the money you gave him to visit prostitutes and even found a low-profile celebrity. Wow, Sanxing Group is indeed wealthy. Having a security guard as a boyfriend is nothing, but paying a boyfriend to keep a mistress is unheard of."

"You, don't talk nonsense. Woo Jae is not that kind of person." Lee Boo-jin suddenly lost her composure. She just thought the security guard was nice. Even though they hadn't been dating much, she would occasionally give him little favors, trying to help her boyfriend, who came from a humble background.
"Little sister, you're really serious!" Park Jae-yong was furious. This was truly disrespectful, and being discovered by an outsider was a disgrace to the family.

"Don't worry, I'm not interested in your saga. Whether it's true or not, you can find out with just a phone call. I just want to tell you. This is the information age. There's nothing I don't know, except what color underwear you're wearing today. Haha, just kidding. Please come this way." Zhao An continued walking ahead.

Li Boo-jin's composure was shattered. Having her relationship exposed so quickly was not good news. As Zhao An had said, she chose to keep it secret for the family's benefit. After all, her sister was sent abroad to study because of her secret relationship. Controlling her own marriage? That's impossible, very rare.

Qian Yuling watched all this with interest. She knew her young husband wouldn't let Lee Boo-jin go. But what did this have to do with her? It would be fine if she didn't come in. If she did, she would still call her Big Sister. She was the head of the Zhao family!
Ambitious women are always ambitious wherever they go, and Qian Yuling is no exception. The difference is that she's now in love with Zhao An, so naturally, she's always thinking about him first.
The group continued forward, soon arriving at a playground.
Zhao An snapped his fingers, and a swarm of drones took off. A self-balancing scooter with a display screen slowly approached, its image constantly changing.

"This is my latest invention, a drone. It can take aerial photos. The photography industry is bound to become increasingly high-end in the future. I'm talking about serious photography. Private photos and adult photography don't fall into that category." Zhao An displayed his inventions. Many were ubiquitous items from a previous life, but now, more than a decade later, they're breathtakingly high-tech gadgets!

Park Jae-yong's eyes lit up. Used well, this kind of thing could be a powerful negotiating tool, definitely allowing the Shanxing Group to advance further in the division of profits in the upcoming negotiations. "Mr. Zhao, I think we could sit down and have a proper discussion at noon. Our group is very interested in your company's inventions."

"Of course, that's no problem. Do you need to take care of anything else first? Wife, please entertain Ms. Lee while Mr. Park and I continue our walk." Zhao An, without the slightest hint of disguising himself, called Qian Yuling "wife" in front of the two of them.

This word of "wife" made Qian Yuling inexplicably overjoyed. Although she claimed she didn't want to get married, it was to give Zhao An a good future and not be held back by her. This was simply for the man's benefit. However, when her status was recognized, she naturally felt very proud, this official affirmation.
"No problem, leave it to me." Qian Yuling's smile grew even brighter. Nothing made her happier than a man's affirmation.
Park Jae-yong's eyes flickered, and he immediately gave up the idea of seducing Qian Yuling. A woman with such determination, seduction was just wishful thinking.

After a stroll, the two of them prepared to eat in a private room at the restaurant.
"I wonder if Mr. Zhao is interested in selling his technology?" Park Jae-yong asked. There was no need to beat around the bush; this was a negotiation.

"I'm not interested in selling it, but I'm open to an exclusive license for a few years. There are only two companies that make Android phone systems: Sanxing Group and Motorola. I don't care about market distribution. But the mainland market is mine, and I'm going to kick Apple out." Zhao An began to carve up the market.
Isn't it a bit too soon to talk about market division before we've even agreed on a price?
"How many years of exclusive licensing?" Park Jae-yong had to consider the timeframe.

"Five years is plenty. You could develop the product yourself in five years. Besides, the fastest time from product release to imitation is two years. If you crack down on pirates, you can even push it down to three." Zhao An swirled his red wine, his expression calm, even a hint of calm evil.
Park Jae-yong nodded, then asked, "What's a reasonable price?"

"These could even become military products, providing significant controllability in urban defense management. The price is $5 billion a year. Feel free to ask me for any technical difficulties you encounter." Zhao An didn't ask for an exorbitant price, but instead gave a reasonable price. "I don't like haggling. It's a flat price. If it's okay, it's fine."

Park Jae-yong's mind raced through many possibilities. After calculating the price, he asked about the price of the finished materials. This involves issues like whether the raw materials can be produced in-house and whether the sources are sufficient.
The larger the business, the more considerations there are. Profits are determined by costs; the lower the costs, the higher the profits. Everyone understands this.
"That's fine, no problem." Park Jae-yong agreed after a moment's calculation.

"Excellent, it's a pleasure working with you. You're much more tactful than other South Korean chaebols. Let's have a drink. I wish us a happy cooperation!" Zhao An clinked his glass with the other man, clearly having planned everything.
"Happy working with you!" Park Jae-yong also took a hearty sip.
After a pause, the main business was basically concluded. The rest was the secretaries' job: to organize the contract, verify it, and sign it if there were no issues.
Park Jae-yong poured Zhao An a glass of wine. "Mr. Zhao, is Ms. Qian really your wife?"

"Of course, we just haven't gotten married yet. Women, who has only one? Yuling helps me manage the company. She and I just lack a marriage certificate. Besides, what's a marriage certificate to us? Just a piece of waste paper, isn't it, Mr. Park?" Zhao An's smile grew even more sinister.
"Haha, that's right, that's right." Park Jae-yong let out a laugh only men could understand.

What a joke! The sons of wealthy families are never known for following the rules. It's perfectly normal for a man to have several mistresses. Having mistresses is powerful, and it can protect them from being cuckolded, so having several is fine.
After three rounds of drinks, Park Jae-yong began to inquire, "Mr. Zhao, are you interested in getting married?"

"Marriage? I don't want to. I can have as many women as I want before marriage, but it wouldn't be appropriate after marriage." Zhao An had no intention of getting married. It was the same with everyone he met. It was best to avoid such matters. Why choose a life of hardship when you can enjoy the glitz and glamour?
"Interesting! Actually, I think only a peerless beauty could be worthy of a talent like Mr. Zhao." Park Jae-yong began to flatter him. This wasn't mean of him.

With the Shanxing Group still plagued by internal strife, he needed more help to secure his position as heir. Zhao An was clearly a very good choice. First, Zhao An wasn't South Korean and wouldn't be involved in the group's internal affairs, so Park Jae-yong wouldn't have to risk being stigmatized.
Second, Zhao An was truly capable. A talent like him could create untold wealth. For him, many new ideas were ways to make money, and they were all very promising.
"What do you think of my sister, Lee Boo-jin?" Park Jae-yong made a decision after considering Zhao An's abilities.

"Not bad, very good, and it's a threat to your position. But South Korea probably wouldn't let a woman take the top job, so the threat wouldn't be that great. But marrying her would just cause trouble for you and strengthen your competitors. Forget it, it's none of my business. It's far removed from me." Zhao An's words were a bit rude, not the kind of thing a person of status and culture would say.

Park Jae-yong didn't mind, instead finding him quite happy. In fact, he felt a little disdainful of this humble figure. But profit was key; it didn't matter who it was, as long as they could bring profit. "How could that be? I feel very close to Mr. Zhao."

"Alright, let's stop beating around the bush. We can cooperate, but the prerequisite for this cooperation is that we speak frankly. I'm quite busy and have many lovers. So, to be brief, it's good for both of us," Zhao An said, shrugging and taking a sip from his glass.
"Haha, good, Mr. Zhao is a quick-witted man indeed. I think my sister and Mr. Zhao are a perfect match, what do you think?" Park Jae-yong bared his fangs, wary of his sister's abilities.

Because of the family's patriarchal emphasis, a woman's heirship would undoubtedly be a non-starter. However, Lee Boo-jin was indeed very capable, managing her hotels well and generating high profits. If she married off, her earning power would simply benefit her rivals, which would be a problem.

After much deliberation, the idea was to bring her to mainland China. This would benefit Zhao An, win over the pervert, and allow him to properly handle Lee Boo-jin's affairs. It was a win-win situation, hence Park Jae-yong's enthusiasm.
